messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

Capabilities explicitly supported in the passages, without an AI-specific ranking, include wide RF frequency coverage, such as SMW200A RF path A options up to 67 GHz and SMM100A coverage up to 44 GHz [16][25].
Wide vector/I/Q modulation bandwidth is supported, with SMW200A wideband baseband up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth, SMM100A internal RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, and SMBV100B RF modulation bandwidth up to 1 GHz [13][25][23].
Large ARB memory, high sample rate, and waveform bandwidth are supported, including SMW200A wideband ARB up to 2 Gsample and 2400 MHz sample rate, SMCV100B ARB up to 1 Gsample and 240 MHz RF bandwidth, and SGT100A ARB up to 1 Gsample and 240 MHz RF bandwidth [14][67][39].
Real-time and standards-based signal generation is supported, including SMW200A internal standards such as 5G NR, LTE, NB-IoT, eMTC and WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay, plus SMM100A 5G NR FR1/FR2 and internal real-time signal generation [16][25].
Multichannel, MIMO and fading generation are supported on SMW200A with up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and single-instrument MIMO fading scenarios such as 2x2, 4x4, 8x4 and 4x8 [13].
Digital I/Q connectivity is supported, including SMW200A lossless Digital I/Q connections to other R&S instruments and SMCV100B DIG I/Q HS over QSFP+/QSFP 28 with lossless connection examples such as SMW200A [15][70].
Impairment and signal-conditioning capabilities are supported, including AWGN, enhanced noise generation, notched signals, crest factor reduction, predistortion, frequency response correction and envelope tracking [80][87][20].
Waveform replay and flexible arbitrary-source generation are supported on CMX500 GPRF Generator through ARB, CW, dual tone, replay of `.wv` files, and waveform replay from IQ capture, MATLAB or other sources [41][42].
Fast automated source operation is supported on SGT100A, with PCIe or Ethernet fast socket arbitrary frequency and level changes specified at less than 500 µs [39].
For AI/data-center context, the passages explicitly identify high-speed electrical interconnect and optical interconnect as part of AI/data-center connectivity, including high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to endpoints and XPO-LPO at 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments [9][8][72].

passages.text:
R&S CMP180 › R&S VSE integration
依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：

- [[R&S VSE]] 是 high-performance analysis software，支援 [[R&S CMP180]] 作為 supported instrument。
- 如果 VSE client license 由 CMP180 提供，需 **R&S CMP-KM150** signal analysis base software。
- R&S CMP-KM152 提供 signal analysis digital。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：

| Designation | Type | Order no. |
|---|---|---|
| Signal analysis base software | R&S CMP-KM150 | 1212.3972.02 |
| Signal analysis, digital | R&S CMP-KM152 | 1212.3989.02 |

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S SMCV100B › Connectors
Front panel：`RF 50 Ω` RF output，`N female`；`USB` 為 `USB 2.0 high speed`、`USB type A`，可接 external USB devices、mouse/keyboard、`R&S®NRPx` power sensors（with `R&S®NRP-Z4` or `R&S®NRP-ZKU` adapter cable）、memory stick。

Rear panel：`Ref. In` / `Ref. Out` 為 `BNC female`；`User 1`, `User 2` 為 user-configurable inputs or outputs，`BNC female`；`Dig. IQ HS 1`, `Dig. IQ HS 2` 為 high speed digital input or output，`QSFP+/QSFP 28`；`IP Data` 為 `SFP+`；rear USB 為 2 connectors，`USB 3.0 high speed`，`USB type A`；`LAN` 為 `RJ-45`；`DisplayPort` 可接 external monitor。

R&S SMCV100B › 定位與用途
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，[[R&S SMCV100B]] 是 Vector Signal Generator，內含 baseband generator with ARB（`64 Msample`、`60 MHz RF bandwidth`），可搭配 RF frequency extension、high output power、low phase noise、digital baseband interface、ARB memory/bandwidth extensions、digital standards、stream libraries 與 [[HUMS]] options。

R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › 與既有概念的關係
- [[Data center server 高速互連產品組合]] 偏向 data center server interconnect portfolio 的分類表；[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 更強調 full-spectrum：electrical interconnect + optical + fiber + power + cooling。
- [[Compute tray component solutions]] 偏向 compute tray connectors、cables、power connector、busbar 與 backplane interconnect；本頁納入 optical transceiver、CPO、fiber deployment 與 liquid cooling。
- [[高速伺服器儲存互連]] 可連接本頁中的 [[Mini Cool Edge IO]]、[[Cool Express Link]]、[[Direct Attached Copper Cables]]、[[PCIe CEM 7 Connectors]] 與 storage / EDSFF 類產品。

- 來源為 Rohde & Schwarz R&S®SMB100B Signal Generator 規格文件，涵蓋 R&S®SMB100B RF Signal Generator 與 R&S®SMB100B Microwave Signal Generator；文件代碼 PD 3607.8182.22，Specifications Version 12.00，日期 September 2025。

- RF modulation bandwidth 最大 signal bandwidth 取決於 baseband option configuration：`8 kHz < f ≤ 240 MHz` 為 `±50% of carrier frequency`；`f > 240 MHz` 為 `±120 MHz`。

- Image sideband suppression：entire instrument in modulation bandwidth，up to `240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth`，`> 80 dB measured`，圖中少數頻率除外。

R&S SMW200A › Floating license rules
- 某些 software options 可在 two-path instruments 中安裝一次或兩次。
- 多數 path-specific software options 採 floating license concept。
- 若 option features 要同時在兩個 paths 使用，該 option 必須安裝兩次。
- 若 option 只安裝一次，只能在 path A 或 path B 其中之一使用。
- Software option 不綁定特定 path。
- 對 baseband generator 也是類似規則：若兩個 baseband generators 要同時輸出相同 standard 或 waveform，對應 software option 必須安裝兩次。

Capabilities explicitly supported in the passages, without an AI-specific ranking, include wide RF frequency coverage, such as SMW200A RF path A options up to 67 GHz and SMM100A coverage up to 44 GHz [16][25].
Wide vector/I/Q modulation bandwidth is supported, with SMW200A wideband baseband up to 2 GHz RF modulation bandwidth, SMM100A internal RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, and SMBV100B RF modulation bandwidth up to 1 GHz [13][25][23].
Large ARB memory, high sample rate, and waveform bandwidth are supported, including SMW200A wideband ARB up to 2 Gsample and 2400 MHz sample rate, SMCV100B ARB up to 1 Gsample and 240 MHz RF bandwidth, and SGT100A ARB up to 1 Gsample and 240 MHz RF bandwidth [14][67][39].
Real-time and standards-based signal generation is supported, including SMW200A internal standards such as 5G NR, LTE, NB-IoT, eMTC and WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay, plus SMM100A 5G NR FR1/FR2 and internal real-time signal generation [16][25].
Multichannel, MIMO and fading generation are supported on SMW200A with up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and single-instrument MIMO fading scenarios such as 2x2, 4x4, 8x4 and 4x8 [13].
Digital I/Q connectivity is supported, including SMW200A lossless Digital I/Q connections to other R&S instruments and SMCV100B DIG I/Q HS over QSFP+/QSFP 28 with lossless connection examples such as SMW200A [15][70].
Impairment and signal-conditioning capabilities are supported, including AWGN, enhanced noise generation, notched signals, crest factor reduction, predistortion, frequency response correction and envelope tracking [80][87][20].
Waveform replay and flexible arbitrary-source generation are supported on CMX500 GPRF Generator through ARB, CW, dual tone, replay of `.wv` files, and waveform replay from IQ capture, MATLAB or other sources [41][42].
Fast automated source operation is supported on SGT100A, with PCIe or Ethernet fast socket arbitrary frequency and level changes specified at less than 500 µs [39].
For AI/data-center context, the passages explicitly identify high-speed electrical interconnect and optical interconnect as part of AI/data-center connectivity, including high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to endpoints and XPO-LPO at 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments [9][8][72].
